title: Vault Impact Junior Electronic Drum Kit for Kids & Beginners – All-Mesh Pads, USB-C & 60+ Sounds
desc:
The Vault Impact Junior is a compact and beginner-friendly electronic drum kit designed for kids, beginners, first-time drummers, and adults up to 5'2" (157 cm) tall. Its compact dimensions and adjustable setup make it comfortable and accessible for younger players and shorter adults who are starting their drumming journey.

This makes it ideal for bedroom practice, apartments, and shared living spaces. The simplified layout and smaller pad sizes provide an easy and comfortable playing experience for new users. At the heart of the kit is a USB-C-powered sound module that offers convenient plug-and-play portability and compatibility with standard power banks. This makes the Impact Junior a practical choice for small home setups and portable practice sessions, without relying on bulky adapters or a nearby wall socket.

The module comes loaded with 68 high-quality drum sounds and 12 genre-based preset drum kits, covering popular styles such as rock, hip-hop, and classic acoustic drums. It also includes jam-along songs that make practice more enjoyable and engaging, helping players develop rhythm, coordination, and creativity from day one.

Built to handle energetic practice sessions, the rubber-rimmed mesh pads are durable, responsive, and comfortable to play. The compact frame is also quick and convenient to set up.

Whether you are a parent looking for a reliable first drum kit for your child, a beginner learning the basics, or an adult under 5'2" looking for a compact practice solution, the Vault Impact Junior delivers excellent value, convenience, and performance.
